```{r}
library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
walk(list.files("R", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.R$"), ~ source(.x, local = triggerR))

gps_utci <- triggerR$read_gps_utci(resolution = "hourly", neighbours = 1) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(hour_ts, tz = "UTC"),
         month = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(hour_ts, "month")))

stress_levels <- c("Extreme cold", "Very strong cold", "Strong cold", "Moderate cold", "Slight cold",
                   "No thermal stress", "Moderate heat", "Strong heat", "Very strong heat", "Extreme heat")
stress_colors <- c(
  "Extreme cold" = "#1E3A8A", "Very strong cold" = "#2563EB",
  "Strong cold" = "#60A5FA", "Moderate cold" = "#93C5FD",
  "Slight cold" = "#DBEAFE", "No thermal stress" = "#D1D5DB",
  "Moderate heat" = "#FDBA74", "Strong heat" = "#FB923C",
  "Very strong heat" = "#EA580C", "Extreme heat" = "#B91C1C")

gps_utci <- gps_utci |>
  mutate(stress = cut(utci, breaks = c(-Inf, -40, -27, -13, 0, 9, 26, 32, 38, 46, Inf),
                      labels = stress_levels, right = FALSE))
```

## GPS–UTCI coverage

Counts below refer to **participant-hours with a GPS observation**, not all hours in the study period. A GPS hour is assigned only when its grid cells satisfy the spatial rule; UTCI coverage additionally requires a non-missing UTCI value for the assigned grid point and hour.

```{r}
coverage <- gps_utci |>
  summarise(participants = n_distinct(userId), gps_hours = n(),
            assigned_hours = sum(assigned, na.rm = TRUE),
            matched_hours = sum(utci_available, na.rm = TRUE),
            assigned_pct = 100 * assigned_hours / gps_hours,
            matched_pct = 100 * matched_hours / gps_hours,
            matched_given_assigned_pct = if_else(assigned_hours > 0, 100 * matched_hours / assigned_hours, NA_real_))
knitr::kable(coverage, digits = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-coverage
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

gps_utci |>
  mutate(status = case_when(!assigned ~ "GPS not assigned",
                            utci_available ~ "GPS + UTCI",
                            TRUE ~ "Assigned GPS, UTCI missing")) |>
  count(status) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("GPS + UTCI", "Assigned GPS, UTCI missing", "GPS not assigned"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(status, n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("GPS + UTCI" = "#2C7FB8", "Assigned GPS, UTCI missing" = "#FCAE91",
                               "GPS not assigned" = "#BDBDBD"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Participant-hours", title = "Availability of GPS-derived UTCI exposure") +
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
participant_coverage <- triggerR$summarise_gps_utci(gps_utci)
knitr::kable(participant_coverage, digits = 1)
```

## Observed thermal stress

These results describe **hours with both valid GPS grid assignment and UTCI**. They do not represent continuous individual exposure between GPS observations.

```{r}
#| label: fig-stress
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6

gps_utci |>
  filter(utci_available, !is.na(stress)) |>
  count(stress, .drop = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(stress, n, fill = stress)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stress_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Observed participant-hours", title = "Thermal stress at observed GPS locations") +
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
heat_summary <- gps_utci |>
  filter(utci_available) |>
  summarise(observed_hours = n(),
            moderate_heat_hours = sum(utci >= 26),
            strong_heat_hours = sum(utci >= 32),
            very_strong_heat_hours = sum(utci >= 38),
            extreme_heat_hours = sum(utci >= 46),
            max_utci = max(utci))
knitr::kable(heat_summary, digits = 1)
```

## Hot days observed by GPS

A **hot observed day** is a participant-day with at least one matched GPS hour reaching 32 °C UTCI (strong heat stress). A day is not classified as cool merely because no hot hour was observed: GPS sampling may be sparse.

```{r}
daily_exposure <- gps_utci |>
  group_by(userId, date) |>
  summarise(gps_hours = n(), assigned_hours = sum(assigned, na.rm = TRUE),
            utci_hours = sum(utci_available, na.rm = TRUE),
            utci_mean = if (all(is.na(utci))) NA_real_ else mean(utci, na.rm = TRUE),
            utci_max = if (all(is.na(utci))) NA_real_ else max(utci, na.rm = TRUE),
            strong_heat_hours = sum(utci >= 32, na.rm = TRUE),
            very_strong_heat_hours = sum(utci >= 38, na.rm = TRUE),
            extreme_heat_hours = sum(utci >= 46, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(hot_day = utci_hours > 0 & strong_heat_hours > 0)

hot_day_summary <- daily_exposure |>
  summarise(participant_days_with_gps = n(),
            participant_days_with_utci = sum(utci_hours > 0),
            hot_observed_participant_days = sum(hot_day),
            very_strong_heat_participant_days = sum(very_strong_heat_hours > 0),
            extreme_heat_participant_days = sum(extreme_heat_hours > 0))
knitr::kable(hot_day_summary)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hot-days
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

daily_exposure |>
  filter(utci_hours > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, utci_max)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = hot_day), alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(32, 38, 46), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#2C7FB8", "TRUE" = "#D95F0E"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Maximum UTCI in matched GPS hours (°C)",
       title = "Hottest UTCI observed for each participant-day",
       subtitle = "Dashed thresholds: 32, 38 and 46 °C; each point is a participant-day") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-heat-monthly
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

gps_utci |>
  filter(utci_available) |>
  mutate(heat = case_when(utci >= 46 ~ "Extreme heat (≥46 °C)",
                          utci >= 38 ~ "Very strong heat (38–46 °C)",
                          utci >= 32 ~ "Strong heat (32–38 °C)",
                          TRUE ~ "Below strong heat")) |>
  filter(heat != "Below strong heat") |>
  count(month, heat) |>
  ggplot(aes(month, n, fill = heat)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Strong heat (32–38 °C)" = "#FB923C",
                               "Very strong heat (38–46 °C)" = "#EA580C",
                               "Extreme heat (≥46 °C)" = "#B91C1C")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Observed participant-hours", fill = NULL,
       title = "Strong and extreme heat observations over time") +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Hottest observed participant-days

`utci_hours` indicates how many hours support each daily maximum. Days with few matched hours must be interpreted cautiously.

```{r}
daily_exposure |>
  filter(utci_hours > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(utci_max), desc(utci_hours)) |>
  select(userId, date, gps_hours, assigned_hours, utci_hours, utci_mean, utci_max,
         strong_heat_hours, very_strong_heat_hours, extreme_heat_hours) |>
  slice_head(n = 30) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: utci-sleep-coverage

sleep <- triggerR$.read_trigger_csv("sleep_tidy") |>
  select(userId, date, sleepduration) |>
  mutate(userId = as.character(userId)) |>
  distinct(userId, date)

utci_sleep <- gps_utci |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(hour_ts, tz = "UTC")) |>
  group_by(userId, date) |>
  summarise(
    gps_hours = n(),
    utci_hours = sum(!is.na(utci)),
    utci_mean = if (all(is.na(utci))) NA_real_ else mean(utci, na.rm = TRUE),
    utci_max = if (all(is.na(utci))) NA_real_ else max(utci, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(sleep |> mutate(has_sleep = TRUE), by = c("userId", "date")) |>
  mutate(has_sleep = replace_na(has_sleep, FALSE))

utci_sleep |>
  summarise(
    participants = n_distinct(userId),
    gps_days = n(),
    utci_days = sum(utci_hours > 0),
    sleep_days = sum(has_sleep),
    utci_sleep_days = sum(has_sleep & utci_hours > 0),
    hot_days = sum(has_sleep & utci_max >= 32, na.rm = TRUE),
    very_hot_days = sum(has_sleep & utci_max >= 38, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-gps-sleep-calendar
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

gps_days <- gps_utci |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(hour_ts, tz = "UTC")) |>
  distinct(userId, date) |>
  mutate(gps = TRUE)

sleep_days <- sleep |>
  distinct(userId, date) |>
  mutate(sleep = TRUE)

calendar <- full_join(gps_days, sleep_days, by = c("userId", "date")) |>
  mutate(
    gps = replace_na(gps, FALSE),
    sleep = replace_na(sleep, FALSE),
    coverage = case_when(
      gps & sleep ~ "GPS + Sleep",
      gps ~ "GPS only",
      sleep ~ "Sleep only"
    )
  )

ggplot(calendar, aes(x = date, y = fct_rev(factor(userId)), fill = coverage)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.9, height = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "GPS + Sleep" = "#238B45",
    "GPS only" = "#3182BD",
    "Sleep only" = "#FDAE6B"
  )) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Participant", fill = "Data availability",
       title = "GPS and sleep data availability by participant and day") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
